## Triage: first grade, `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T21:03Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3 (the filer's):** the spec declares `element:text` content as "Text or Markdown" and the renderer prints Markdown verbatim. That is a declared-but-not-honoured key.
- **For the claimant:** Enforce it with the console's existing Markdown renderer and its sanitizer. ⛔ No new dependency.

Claim: PM loop round 15, serial (`priority:p3`; triage grade `6224655569`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12778-element-text-markdown`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12778` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the card's first "Done when" arm. `element:text` renders the declared Markdown subset safely, as triage directs: "Enforce it with the console's existing Markdown renderer and its sanitizer. ⛔ No new dependency."
- `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx`, `ElementTextRenderer` (`:157`, `main` `2b0ab94`). The content is drawn through an inline Markdown subset: links, `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `` `code` `` and plain text. The rendering is done by React elements, never by HTML strings.
  - Raw HTML is never rendered. It is skipped, as objectui#12146 skips it in the console's renderer.
  - A link's `href` is kept only for `http:`, `https:`, `mailto:`, `tel:` or a relative or absolute path; any other scheme (`javascript:`, `data:`, `vbscript:` …) renders as plain text. The package's peer range admits React 18, which does not block `javascript:` URLs.
  - Block Markdown (headings, lists, fences) is not drawn inside a `p` / `h1`–`h6` tag. Say what the subset does with it.
- The renderer is the console's existing zero-dependency one: `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarkdownText.tsx` (its `renderInline`, `:192`). `@object-ui/components` cannot import `app-shell` (it is below it).
  - The preferred route is one implementation: move the inline half into `@object-ui/components`, and have `MarkdownText` call it.
  - Copying it instead is a stop-and-report.
  - The link-scheme rule then also covers the marketplace README renderer, which today passes `href` through as written (`:201`).
- Tests beside the existing `elements` / `ElementTextRenderer` and `MarkdownText` families: a link and bold text render. CONTROLS: a `javascript:` link renders as text, raw HTML is not rendered, and plain text with a lone `*` is unchanged. One `.changeset/12778-*.md` per touched released package.

Outside the surface:
- `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` and the `fields` rich-text display, which use `react-markdown`;
- the spec's description of `ElementTextPropsSchema.content` (the second arm, not taken);
- any new npm dependency.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: if the shared inline renderer is exported from `@object-ui/components` for `app-shell`'s `MarkdownText` to import, that is a new export on a published entry. The `element:text` change alone honours a key the spec already declares, which is not a widening. The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review covers it before ready.
Responsibility: (1) objectui's own code: `ElementTextRenderer` prints `pickLocalized(content)` verbatim though the spec declares `ElementTextPropsSchema.content` as "Text or Markdown content" | (2) no platform path covers it: the server passes the string through, and the console's Markdown renderers are not on this path | (3) every page that authors Markdown in `element:text`; named producer: objectstack-ai/cloud#2918 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2937), whose pricing-page footer link became a separate button because of this
Thread-read: 6224655569
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `2b0ab94`. No open PR names `elements.tsx` or `MarkdownText.tsx` (the open non-bot PR, #12881, is the app-page related lists). The seat holds no other card in flight (serial mode); objectui#12333 landed in `6234388674`.

Posted by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`) verbatim from the cloud session's final message, because a cloud session cannot comment from its container. The seat filled `pr` with the draft PR it opened, #12893.

**The seat's answers:**
- **Open question 1 (link target): A, as taken.** The named producer's link is a `mailto:` inside a sentence, and a new tab for it opens an empty window. A same-site path is in-app navigation. The target follows from the `href`, so there is no author-facing knob for an AI to set wrong, and no prop is added. README links keep a new tab, as before.
- **Open question 2 (flanking rule on the README side): A, as taken.** It is CommonMark's own rule, the objectui#12146 README fixtures pass unchanged, and one implementation was the point of the claim's preferred route. A second, looser rule for READMEs would be the copy the claim calls a stop-and-report.
- **The seat read the diff** at `8ff1d52`: 8 files, +402/−62, all on the claimed surface.
  - `inline-markdown.tsx` is `MarkdownText`'s inline pass moved, not rewritten, plus `safeLinkHref` (an allow-list: a scheme it does not name is refused, and whitespace or a control character in the `href` is refused before the scheme is read) and the flanking and single-backtick tightenings the ablations C and D pin.
  - `elements.tsx` changes one line of rendering and adds the class/target options; `MarkdownText.tsx` keeps its block parser and imports the grammar pieces it used to define.
  - The regex lookbehind in the code-span pattern is not a new browser floor: `packages/components/src/lib/lazy-icon.tsx` already ships one.
  - The merge `8ff1d52` brings only `main` (`26323c4`, the `18.0.0-next.3` bump). Commit trailers are model-free.
- **`Clause-②: yes`** is the export the claim anticipated: `renderInlineMarkdown`, `InlineMarkdownOptions` and the two raw-HTML grammar sources join the `@object-ui/components` entry so `app-shell` holds no second copy. The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review of that surface goes in the ACCEPT.
- **Deviations accepted:** the empty probe push was skipped (the first push answered without a 403), and the worktree is left in an ephemeral container.
- **The seat's edits to the PR body:** the dev's session and footer lines are replaced with the provenance paragraph, and one Acceptance-notes example is reworded so the body carries no tag-shaped text. Next: CI on `8ff1d52`, then the ACCEPT.

## Landed · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o` · 2026-10-17T14:50Z

- **Merged:** PR #12893 landed through the merge queue as `main` `d2b21a1225`, with one parent, `1d872f2f70`. It is an ancestor of `origin/main`.
- **Verified by content:** the merge commit's own diff equals the PR's diff from its merge-base `26323c4fc8` to the reviewed head `8ff1d52`, changed line for changed line in each of the 8 files (+402/−62).
- **Positive control at the merge commit:** `packages/components/src/lib/inline-markdown.tsx` exists, and `elements.tsx` renders `renderInlineMarkdown(pickLocalized(…))`. Neither is present at the parent `1d872f2f70`.
- **Card:** closed `completed` by `Fixes #12778`. `element:text` now draws the inline Markdown its spec declares, so the pricing footer's `mailto:` link (objectstack-ai/cloud#2918) can sit inside its sentence. The marketplace README renderer shares the same link-scheme allow-list. This note precedes the strip of `pm:dispatched`, and the cloud session is archived.
- **Next, outside this card:** none filed. The card's other arm (retiring "or Markdown" from the spec's description of `content`) is moot: the declaration is now honoured.
